name: mushky gansbourg
text: Great service. Printed beautiful bat mitzva invitations. Delivered in a timely manner

name: Stephanie Iskhakov
text: Save yourself the mental anguish of working with this company. They are much cheaper than any other printer we have ever worked with but it is just not worth what they put their customers through. Spend more money and work with someone pleasant.

name: Chabad of Cheviot Hills
text: BH thank you for your amazing prompt and professional service!

name: Yisroel Gordon
text: Very happy with Sprinting. Great pricing, quick service.

name: Gian Paredes
text: Sprinting is by far the best printing service in Long Beach! They offer great pricing, fast lead times and great customer service. They have great quality paper and really helped us create the best catalogs possible. We will be sure to have all our future projects printed with Sprinting!

name: Maria Luquin
text:
I went in to ask if I could print out two documents & Isaiah was very helpful. He greeted me and gave me the email address to sent my documents to.
I’ll definitely be going back if needed and now know I can print much more with them too!

They have a small entrance. The door wasn’t open at the time I went but it was unlocked. It’s too hot to have it open lol.
This is a picture of the entrance!

name: Francine Pule
text: The workers are nice and get the job done fast, this is my #1 go to place for whenever i need things printed
